landing.announce: Prototype: bilingual HR, workforce intelligence, financial services, and fraud prevention.

hero.title: One platform for your people, intelligence, and growth.
hero.body: Manage the employee lifecycle, connect workers to financial benefits, automate HR operations, and protect your organization with AI-powered fraud and anomaly detection.

platform.title: A modular platform that grows with your organization.
platform.body: Start with core HR. Add employee financial services, fraud prevention, sector compliance, analytics, and AI as your needs grow.

cards.title: Core HR & Employee Records
cards.body: Digital employee files, contracts, departments, branches, document tracking, workflows, and role-based access.

cards.title: AI Workforce Intelligence
cards.body: Turnover signals, contract alerts, staffing insights, policy assistance, workforce forecasting, and executive reporting.

cards.title: Employee Financial Services
cards.body: Salary advances, affordable credit, health insurance, savings products, benefits, and payroll-connected services.

cards.title: Fraud & Anomaly Prevention
cards.body: Detect ghost employees, duplicate identities, suspicious payroll changes, conflicts of interest, and unusual activity.

lifecycle.title: Everything HR teams need. One connected experience.

tiles.title: Recruitment & Onboarding
tiles.body: Applicant tracking, interviews, offers, background checks, and digital onboarding.

tiles.title: Time, Leave & Attendance
tiles.body: Leave requests, shifts, overtime, country calendars, approvals, and attendance.

tiles.title: Performance & Learning
tiles.body: Goals, reviews, probation, skills, training compliance, and succession planning.

tiles.title: Payroll Preparation
tiles.body: Salaries, deductions, allowances, bonuses, bank exports, payslips, and approvals.

tiles.title: Employee Self-Service
tiles.body: Mobile-friendly access to payslips, leave, documents, benefits, and policies.

tiles.title: Workflow Automation
tiles.body: Approvals for hiring, promotion, travel, expenses, contracts, and disciplinary cases.

financial.title: Connect workers to financial services through the workplace.
financial.body: Give employees access to responsible financial products while employers retain secure, governed administration.

feature.title: Turn payroll into a gateway to financial wellbeing.
feature.body: Partner with banks, insurers, and regulated lenders to offer salary-linked products directly within Dival People.

minis.title: Salary Advances
minis.body: Controlled access to earned wages and employer-approved advances.

minis.title: Affordable Credit
minis.body: Connect employees to responsible banks and microfinance partners.

minis.title: Health Insurance
minis.body: Compare plans, enroll dependents, and manage contributions.

minis.title: Savings & Benefits
minis.body: Support savings plans, pensions, and financial education.

fraud.title: Built-in protection for banks, telecoms, NGOs, and regulated organizations.
fraud.body: Dival People identifies suspicious patterns and routes them for human review without replacing compliance or investigative judgment.

industries.title: One platform. Tailored for each organization.
industries.body: Deploy specialized workflows, controls, and analytics on the same DIP foundation.

cards.title: Financial Services
cards.body: HR, compliance training, insider-risk controls, background verification, and payroll anomaly detection.

cards.title: NGOs & Development
cards.body: Grant staffing, project timesheets, consultant records, contract alerts, safeguarding, and donor reporting.

cards.title: Telecommunications
cards.body: Workforce management, compliance, employee fraud controls, and the TIX customer risk exchange.

cards.title: Government
cards.body: Workforce records, controlled approvals, audit trails, document compliance, and public-sector reporting.

cards.title: Healthcare
cards.body: Credential tracking, shifts, clinical training compliance, workforce planning, and secure employee records.

cards.title: Enterprise
cards.body: A flexible edition for education, insurance, mining, logistics, and multi-country employers.

finalCta.title: Ready to visualize Dival People inside your organization?
finalCta.body: Start with a guided prototype and configure the first industry edition around a real workflow.

footer.builtOn: Built on the Dival Intelligence Platform (DIP).
